New profile

Your spellboard, in a minute.

  1. Choose Tartarus Pro or Keyboard, then choose your class and search the spell library.
  2. Drag an icon onto a control. You can also click a spell, then click a control, or use Tab and Enter.
  3. Click a control to edit its keybind or add a macro reminder. Use Record and press a key or chord (such as Ctrl+Shift+Q) to capture the keybind, or type it manually. Drag between controls to swap their skills.
  4. Use the modifier tabs for separate Base, Shift, Ctrl and Alt assignments. Keybind labels are editable on every layer. Tartarus and keyboard assignments are stored separately in the same profile. Clearing a layer affects only the displayed device.
  5. Save HTML downloads the entire app with your profiles and custom icons inside it. Export / Import creates or restores a JSON backup.

Use Reference view while you play, or print the layout and its assignment list. Press Escape to exit reference view or cancel a selected spell. Ctrl+Z undoes edits when you aren’t typing.

The keyboard view uses a standard US ANSI 104-key layout, including function keys, arrows, navigation keys, and a numpad. Scroll horizontally on smaller screens. Key recording uses physical US key positions; type a label manually for other layouts or system shortcuts the browser cannot capture.

The numbered grid follows the Tartarus Pro: keys 01–19, a scroll wheel, thumb button, eight thumbpad directions, and the spacebar actuator (20). Thumbpad directions are shown expanded so each is an individual drop target.

Use Choose your world to switch between Retail, Classic, and Forever visual themes. Your selection is saved in this browser and in Save HTML downloads. Themes change appearance; the spell library remains the WoW Forever snapshot.

This app is a reference and does not program the device or game. The built-in library is a snapshot, and names or icons may change in future patches. Add custom skills for anything missing.

Sources & credits

502 class spell entries and 397 distinct icons were collected on November 10, 2026 from WCLBox’s WoW Forever spellbook. Only spell names, class / school labels, and icons are included. The snapshot is not a live or exhaustive database; it includes talent skills and utilities listed by the source. Custom skills let you fill any gaps.

The device layout is based on the official Razer Tartarus Pro master guide. The diagram is an original schematic; thumb controls are expanded for readability.

World of Warcraft, original spell icons, and related names belong to Blizzard Entertainment. Razer and Tartarus are trademarks of Razer. This personal fan tool is unaffiliated with either company.

There are no external scripts, fonts, analytics, or network requests. Data stays in this browser or the files you save. Browser storage can be cleared by the browser; keep an HTML or JSON backup.
